name: imdb-wrapped
description: Personal IMDb Wrapped — fork, paste your profile URL, drop in your export CSVs.

scripts.copy-data: mkdir -p public/data && cp -f src/data/stats.json src/data/watchlist.json public/data/
scripts.build: npm run copy-data && python3 scripts/build_og.py && vite build
scripts.build:imdb: npm run copy-data && python3 scripts/build_og.py && VITE_BASE=/imdb/ vite build
scripts.data: python3 scripts/build_stats.py --fast && python3 scripts/fetch_watchlist.py && python3 scripts/build_og.py && npm run copy-data
scripts.data:full: python3 scripts/build_stats.py && python3 scripts/fetch_watchlist.py --live && python3 scripts/build_og.py && npm run copy-data
